statement: CoreWeave on-demand rate card lists the NVIDIA HGX H100 8-GPU node at $49.24 per hour, approximately $6.155 per GPU-hour, in North America.
why: Published rental rates are the visible price level for renting merchant GPUs, useful as a confirmation overlay even though no baseline or change is given.

impact.mechanism: Rate-card levels show what renters currently pay for H100 capacity; with no prior period stated, no direction can be inferred.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA HGX H100: '$49.24' per hour (8-GPU node, i.e. approx. $6.155/GPU-hr).

confidence.basis: Vendor rate-card page observed directly, but per-GPU figure is derived by dividing the node price by eight and no baseline is published.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 8.6 -> 6.155 (tol 1%); sources: coreweave.com
